community: Blackfoot nations (Siksika, Blood Tribe, Piikani); Horse Lake; O’Chiese, Sunchild; Enoch; Stoney Nakoda (Eden Valley, Big Horn)
request: Put Piikani in Cardston-Siksika with Siksika and Blood so the three Blackfoot nations share one MLA; also move Horse Lake to Central Peace-Notley, put O’Chiese and Sunchild with Enoch in Drayton Valley-Devon, and reunite Eden Valley and Big Horn with the Stoney Nakoda in Banff-Kananaskis.
quote: These First Nations share much more than just the language. They share the same constituent concerns and deserve one MLA that represents them and their unique needs.
note: Speaks as Indigenous MLA and member of Alexander FN, not on behalf of a nation. Says uninhabited additions to reserve (Piikani timber limit, Alexander carve-outs) are not what he means except Piikani inclusion. Also cites Maskwacis-Wetaskiwin and Lac Ste. Anne-Parkland (Alexander, Alexis, Paul) as good examples. Mrs. Samson is a commissioner (keyword hit).
